english_sentence: He works systematically, so there's no need to worry.

cantonese_sentence: 啲垃圾好有味呀！
jyutping_sentence: di1 laap1 saap3 hou2 jau5 mei6 aa3!
english_sentence: This trash is very smelly!

cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司好有面㗎。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 hou2 jau5 min6 gaa3.
english_sentence: He's very respected in the company.

english: Have feathers and wings; to have enough information to carry out a task
cantonese_sentence: 佢講到件事有毛有翼咁，睇嚟都幾肯定。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 dou3 gin6 si6 jau5 mou4 jau5 jik6 gam2, tai2 lai4 dou1 gei2 hang2 ding6.
english_sentence: He talked about the matter as if he had all the information, so it seems he is quite certain.

cantonese_sentence: 1.  Jyutping: jau5 mou5 gaau2 co3
jyutping_sentence: 2.  Brief English meaning: Are you kidding me? What's going on? Are you out of your mind? (Expresses disbelief, frustration, or shock)
english_sentence: 3.  Natural Cantonese sentence using the word: 你咁樣做，有冇搞錯呀？

english: To have an idea; to be thinking of something
cantonese_sentence: 我都有啲有念頭想轉工。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dou1 jau5 di1 jau5 nim6 tau4 soeng2 zyun2 gung1.
english_sentence: I'm having some thoughts about changing jobs.

english: Ruthless; lacking consideration for others, biting (in a hurtful way). Often used to describe someone who is sarcastic or unkind.
cantonese_sentence: 佢講嘢有牙冇眼，次次都拮到人哋㷫烚烚。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gong2 je5 jau5 ngaa4 mou5 ngaan5, ci3 ci3 dou1 gat1 dou2 jan4 dei6 hing3 hap1 hap1.
english_sentence: He speaks ruthlessly, every time he stings people until they are furious.

english: To have support and backing; to have someone to rely on.
cantonese_sentence: 佢喺公司有挨有憑，所以做嘢都好大胆。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 jau5 aai1 jau5 ping3, so2 ji5 zou6 je5 dou1 hou2 daai6 daam2.
english_sentence: He has backing in the company, so he's very bold when he does things.

english: Obvious; plain to see; it's clear.
cantonese_sentence: 件事咁明顯，有眼睇都知佢哋拍拖啦！
jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 gam3 ming4 hin2, jau5 ngaan5 tai2 dou1 zi1 keoi5 dei6 paak3 to1 laa1!
english_sentence: The matter is so obvious, anyone can see that they're dating!

cantonese_sentence: 你咁有腦，一定識得解決呢個問題啦。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 gam3 jau5 nou5, jat1 ding6 sik1 dak1 gaai2 kyut3 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 laa1.
english_sentence: You're so brainy, you must know how to solve this problem.

english: a long time; quite a while
cantonese_sentence: 排隊買演唱會飛有排等呀！
jyutping_sentence: paai4 deoi2 maai5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 fei1 jau5 paai4 dang2 aa3!
english_sentence: Queuing to buy concert tickets will take quite a while!

cantonese_sentence: 佢根本係個有牌爛仔，專恰啲弱小。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gan1 bun2 hai6 go3 jau5 paai4 laan6 zai2, zyun1 hap1 di1 joek6 siu2.
english_sentence: He's basically a licensed thug, specializing in bullying the weak.

jyutping: jau5 bin6 ji4 m4 sai2 geng2
english: If it's a bargain, don't hesitate (to grab it quickly/compete for it). Literally "If there's a bargain, don't need neck (to stretch your neck to see/compete)"
cantonese_sentence: 見到減價貨，梗係有便宜唔使頸啦！
jyutping_sentence: gin3 dou2 gaam2 gaa3 fo3, gang2 hai6 jau5 bin6 ji4 m4 sai2 geng2 laa1!
english_sentence: When you see discounted goods, of course, you grab it without hesitation!

english: No guarantees if you get hurt (doing something dangerous); no compensation for injury.
cantonese_sentence: 我地玩呢個遊戲，有殺冇賠㗎，你諗清楚先啊！
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 waan2 ni1 go3 jau4 hei3, jau5 saat3 mou5 pui4 gaa3, nei5 naam2 cing1 co2 sin1 aa3!
english_sentence: Playing this game, there are no guarantees if you get hurt, think carefully first!

jyutping: jau5 saat3 co3 mou5 fong3 gwo3
english: Better to kill the innocent than let the guilty go (drastic and ruthless policy)
cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢嘅原則係「有殺錯冇放過」。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 ge3 jyun4 zak1 hai6 "jau5 saat3 co3 mou5 fong3 gwo3".
english_sentence: His principle in working is "better to kill the innocent than let the guilty go."

cantonese_sentence: 佢好有心機整呢份禮物俾你。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 jau5 sam1 gei1 zing2 ni1 fan6 lai5 mat6 bei2 nei5.
english_sentence: He/She put a lot of thought into making this gift for you.

english: Willing in spirit but lacking the physical ability
cantonese_sentence: 佢都想幫手，但係有心冇神，都係唔好搞搞震啦。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 soeng2 bong1 sau2, daan6 hai6 jau5 sam1 mou5 san4, dou1 hai6 m4 hou2 gaau2 gaau2 zan3 laa1.
english_sentence: He wants to help, but he's willing in spirit but lacking the physical ability, so it's better he doesn't cause trouble.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋公司一年有十五日有薪假期。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 jat1 nin4 jau5 sap6 ng5 jat6 jau5 san1 gaa3 kei4.
english_sentence: Our company has fifteen days of paid leave per year.

cantonese_sentence: 佢有咗身紀喇。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 zo2 san1 gei2 laa3.
english_sentence: She is pregnant.

english: Listless; appearing to have energy but actually lacking it
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都好似有神冇氣咁，唔知做乜。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hou2 ci5 jau5 san4 mou5 hei3 gam2, m4 zi1 zou6 mat1.
english_sentence: He/She always seems listless, I don't know why.

cantonese_sentence: 佢有手有腳，點解唔自己搵嘢做？
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 sau2 jau5 goek3, dim2 gaai2 m4 zi6 gei2 wan2 je5 zou6?
english_sentence: He's able-bodied, why doesn't he find work for himself?

english: To hold a grudge; to bear resentment.
cantonese_sentence: 佢哋因為啲小事有仇口好耐。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 jan1 wai6 di1 siu2 si6 jau5 cau4 hau2 hou2 noi6.
english_sentence: They've been holding a grudge against each other for a long time over some trivial matters.

english: To have some news/updates; to hear back from someone
cantonese_sentence: 等咗好耐都冇有聲氣，唔知發生咩事。
jyutping_sentence: dang2 zo2 hou2 noi6 dou1 mou5 jau5 seng1 hei3, m4 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
english_sentence: I've been waiting for a long time and haven't heard back from them, I wonder what happened.

english: Alive and kicking; full of life and energy
cantonese_sentence: 佢啱啱病好，但係睇落都重係有聲有氣嘅。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ngaam1 ngaam1 beng6 hou2, daan6 hai6 tai2 lok6 dou1 zung6 hai6 jau5 seng1 jau5 hei3 ge3.
english_sentence: He just recovered from being sick, but he still looks full of life and energy.

english: To have leftovers, to have some remaining
cantonese_sentence: 食飯食到有剩，打包翻屋企啦。
jyutping_sentence: sik6 faan6 sik6 dou3 jau5 sing6, daa2 baau1 faan1 uk1 kei2 laa1.
english_sentence: I ate until there were leftovers, let's pack them and take them home.

english: Worth considering, worthwhile, there's value to it
cantonese_sentence: 呢個計劃有數為，可以試吓。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 jau5 sou3 wai4, ho2 ji5 si3 haa5.
english_sentence: This plan is worth considering, we can try it out.

cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅嘢食有彈有讚，有啲人話好味，有啲人話麻麻哋。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 je5 sik6 jau5 daan6 jau5 zaan3, jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 hou2 mei6, jau5 di1 jan4 waa6 maa4 maa4 dei2.
english_sentence: This restaurant's food receives mixed reviews, some people say it's delicious, and some say it's just so-so.

english: Has an owner; belongs to someone
cantonese_sentence: 唔好亂咁攞人哋嘅嘢，有頭有主㗎。
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 lo2 jan4 dei6 ge3 je5, jau5 tau4 jau5 zyu2 gaa3.
english_sentence: Don't take other people's things randomly, they belong to someone.

cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行有頭有路，好多人都識佢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hong4 jau5 tau4 jau5 lou6, hou2 do1 jan4 dou1 sik1 keoi5.
english_sentence: He is well-connected in this industry, many people know him.

english: to have a beginning and an end; to be thorough; to see something through
cantonese_sentence: 做嘢要有頭有尾，唔好半途而廢。
jyutping_sentence: zou6 je5 jiu3 jau5 tau4 jau5 mei5, m4 hou2 bun3 tou4 ji4 fai3.
english_sentence: When doing things, you should see them through to the end, don't give up halfway.

cantonese_sentence: 佢喺呢行都算係有頭有面嘅人。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 ni1 hong4 dou1 syun3 hai6 jau5 tau4 jau5 min6 ge3 jan4.
english_sentence: He's considered quite influential in this industry.

english: Incomplete; Starting something but not finishing it; Lacking follow-through.
cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日有頭冇尾，真係好難靠得住。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 jau5 tau4 mou5 mei5, zan1 hai6 hou2 naan4 kaau3 dak1 zyu6.
english_sentence: He always starts things but doesn't finish them, it's really hard to rely on him.

jyutping: jau5 tau4 wai1, mou5 mei5 zan6
english: Starts strong but fades quickly, lacking staying power
cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢成日都係有頭威，冇尾陣，所以冇乜嘢做到尾。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 seng4 jat6 dou1 hai6 jau5 tau4 wai1, mou5 mei5 zan6, so2 ji5 mou5 mat1 je5 zou6 dou3 mei5.
english_sentence: He always starts strong but fades quickly in his work, so he doesn't finish much.

english: Prompt and reliable; no delays or defaults (literally: "having delays, not owing")
cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢有拖冇欠，可以放心交俾佢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 jau5 to1 mou5 him3, ho2 ji5 fong3 sam1 gaau1 bei2 keoi5.
english_sentence: He's prompt and reliable with his work, you can confidently entrust it to him.

jyutping: jau5 caak6 sam1 mou5 caak6 daam2
english: To have the desire to be a thief but lack the courage
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日話想發達，但又唔敢做犯法嘅嘢，真係有賊心冇賊膽。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 waa6 soeng2 faat3 daat6, daan6 jau6 m4 gam2 zou6 faan6 faat3 ge3 je5, zan1 hai6 jau5 caak6 sam1 mou5 caak6 daam2.
english_sentence: He always says he wants to get rich, but he doesn't dare to do anything illegal, he really has the desire to be a thief but lacks the courage.

english: So what? / What's the big deal? / What about it? (Often used in a dismissive or challenging way.)
cantonese_sentence: 你話我錯，又點話？
jyutping_sentence: nei5 waa6 ngo5 co3, jau6 dim2 waa6?
english_sentence: You say I'm wrong, so what?

english: Oh, that's right/Oh, I see (with a realization)
cantonese_sentence: 哦，又係噃，我哋聽日唔使返工㗎。
jyutping_sentence: o1, jau6 hai6 bo3, ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 m4 sai2 faan1 gung1 gaa3.
english_sentence: Oh, that's right, we don't have to go to work tomorrow.

jyutping: jau5 jiu3 wai1, jau6 jiu3 daai3 tau4 kwai1
english: Wants to show off, but also wants to protect themselves (hedging their bets/covering their back)
cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都唔識，但係又要扮叻，有要威，又要戴頭盔！
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1, daan6 hai6 jau6 jiu3 baan6 lek1, jau5 jiu3 wai1, jau6 jiu3 daai3 tau4 kwai1!
english_sentence: He doesn't know anything, but he still wants to act like he's smart, wanting to show off but also cover his back!

english: It's not like; it's not as if
cantonese_sentence: 又唔係我整爛嘅，點解要我賠？
jyutping_sentence: jau6 m4 hai6 ngo5 zing2 laan6 ge3, dim2 gaai2 jiu3 ngo5 pui4?
english_sentence: It's not like I broke it, why should I compensate?

english: This and that; all sorts of things; a mixed bag. It can also imply trivial or unimportant things.
cantonese_sentence: 佢屋企好多又乜又物，唔知啲嘢有乜用。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 uk1 kei2 hou2 do1 jau6 mat1 jau6 mat6, m4 zi1 di1 je5 jau5 mat1 jung6.
english_sentence: He/She has so many odds and ends at home, and I don't even know what they're for.

cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢又𠱓又篩，搞到件事拖咗好耐。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 jau6 zaau1 jau6 sai1, gaau2 dou3 gin6 si6 to1 zo2 hou2 noi6.
english_sentence: He's so indecisive at work, it dragged the matter on for a long time.

english: dark and damp; gloomy and humid
cantonese_sentence: 今日又翳又諦，真係唔想出街。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 jau6 ai3 jau6 dai3, zan1 hai6 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1.
english_sentence: It's so dark and damp today, I really don't want to go out.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋又試吓啦！
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jau6 si3 haa5 laa1!
english_sentence: Let's try again!

english: Said... but; Claimed... but; You said... but. Often implies disbelief or contradiction.
cantonese_sentence: 你又話減肥，點解仲食咁多嘢嘅？
jyutping_sentence: nei5 jau6 waa6 gaam2肥, dim2 gaai2 zung6 sik6 gam3 do1 je5 ge3?
english_sentence: You said you were on a diet, why are you still eating so much?

cantonese_sentence: 喺右便轉彎就到㗎喇。
jyutping_sentence: hai2 jau6 bin6 zyun3 waan1 zau6 dou3 gaa3 laa3.
english_sentence: Turn right, and you'll be there.

cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳喺你右手邊。
jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 nei5 jau6 sau2 bin1.
english_sentence: The restaurant is on your right-hand side.

cantonese_sentence: 間餐廳喺你右手便.
jyutping_sentence: gaan1 caan1 teng1 hai2 nei5 jau6 sau2 bin6.
english_sentence: The restaurant is on your right-hand side.

cantonese_sentence: 香港好多日本車都係右軚車。
jyutping_sentence: hoeng1 gong2 hou2 do1 jat6 bun2 che1 dou1 hai6 jau6 taai3 che1.
english_sentence: Many Japanese cars in Hong Kong are right-hand drive cars.

cantonese_sentence: 我爺爺好鍾意飲茶。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 je4 je4 hou2 zung1 ji3 jam2 cha4.
english_sentence: My grandfather likes to drink tea very much.

cantonese_sentence: 我想飲杯椰汁西米露。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 jam2 bui1 je4 zap1 sai1 mai5 lou6.
english_sentence: I want to drink a glass of coconut milk sago.

cantonese_sentence: 阿婆用椰殼裝水飲。
jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 jung6 je4 hok3 zong1 seoi2 jam2.
english_sentence: The grandma used a coconut shell to hold water to drink.

cantonese_sentence: 佢個髮型好似椰殼頭咁。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 faat3 jing4 hou2 ci5 je4 hok3 tau4 gam3.
english_sentence: His/Her hairstyle looks like a coconut head.

cantonese_sentence: 阿婆用椰衣刷鑊
jyutping_sentence: a3 po4 yung6 je4 yi1 caat3 wok6
english_sentence: Grandma uses coconut husk fibre to scrub the wok.

cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食椰汁同埋椰肉
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 je4 zap1 tung4 mai4 je4 juk6
english_sentence: I like to eat coconut juice and coconut meat.

cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食椰茸西多士。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 je4 jung4 sai1 do1 si2.
english_sentence: I like to eat French toast with coconut flakes.

cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食椰絲撻。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 je4 si1 taat3.
english_sentence: I like to eat coconut tart.

cantonese_sentence: 飲啖椰水解下渴先啦！
jyutping_sentence: yam2 daam6 je4 seoi2 gaai2 haa5 hot3 sin1 laa1!
english_sentence: Let's drink some coconut water to quench our thirst first!

cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食炒椰菜。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 caau2 je4 coi3.
english_sentence: I really like eating stir-fried cabbage.

cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食白汁焗椰菜花。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 baak6 zap1 guk6 je4 choi3 faa1.
english_sentence: I like to eat cauliflower gratin (cauliflower baked with white sauce).

english: Provocative, sexy, or easily causing trouble (especially anger or desire)
cantonese_sentence: 條裙真係惹火。
jyutping_sentence: tiu4 kwan4 zan1 hai6 ze5 fo2.
english_sentence: That dress is really provocative/sexy.

english: To get into trouble with the law
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好亂咁嚟喇，小心惹官非呀!
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 lai4 laa1, siu2 sam1 je5 gun1 fei1 aa3!
english_sentence: Don't act recklessly, be careful you don't get into trouble with the law!

english: To cause trouble, to stir up problems, to be a troublemaker
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺學校惹是惹非，搞到老師好頭痕。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 hok6 haau6 ze2 si6 ze2 fei1, gaau2 dou3 lou5 si1 hou2 tau4 han4.
english_sentence: He always causes trouble at school, giving the teachers a headache.

cantonese_sentence: 佢個女好似個野仔咁，成日周圍跑。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 neoi2 hou2 ci5 go3 je5 zai2 gam2, seng4 jat6 zau1 wai4 paau2.
english_sentence: Her daughter is like a tomboy, always running around.

cantonese_sentence: 佢份人好爛，成日去叫野雞。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 jan4 hou2 laan6, sing4 jat6 heoi3 giu3 je5 gai1.
english_sentence: He's a terrible person; he's always going to prostitutes.

cantonese_sentence: 屋企樓下好多野貓
jyutping_sentence: uk1 kei2 lau4 haa6 hou2 do1 je5 maau1
english_sentence: There are many stray cats downstairs in my building.

cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意食野味，覺得太臊。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 m4 zung1 ji3 sik6 je5 mei2, gok3 dak1 taai3 sou1.
english_sentence: I don't like eating game meat, I think it's too gamey.

cantonese_sentence: 你買咗啲乜嘢啊？
jyutping_sentence: nei5 maai5 zo2 di1 mat1 je5 aa3?
english_sentence: What things did you buy?

cantonese_sentence: 今晚好夜喇，瞓覺啦。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 hou2 je6 laa3, fan3 gaau3 laa1.
english_sentence: It's very late tonight, let's go to sleep.

english: Tuberose (a fragrant flower, often blooming at night); night fragrance. Also sometimes used figuratively to refer to streetwalkers.
cantonese_sentence: 我屋企樓下成日有夜香賣。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 uk1 kei2 lau4 haa6 seng4 jat6 jau5 je6 hoeng1 maai6.
english_sentence: There are often tuberose vendors selling flowers downstairs at my house.

english: Later, a bit later, later on
cantonese_sentence: 我哋夜啲再傾啦
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 je6 di1 zoi3 king1 laa1
english_sentence: Let's talk later.

cantonese_sentence: 今晚去夜店玩啦！
jyutping_sentence: gam1 maan5 heoi3 je6 dim3 waan2 laa1!
english_sentence: Let's go to the nightclub tonight!

cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要返夜更。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 faan1 je6 gaang1.
english_sentence: I have to work the night shift tonight.

cantonese_sentence: 我今晚要做夜工啊。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 jiu3 zou6 je6 gung1 aa3.
english_sentence: I have to work the night shift tonight.

cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都做夜鬼，唔夠瞓。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 je6 gwai2, m4 gau3 fan3.
english_sentence: He/She is always a night owl and doesn't get enough sleep.

cantonese_sentence: 我細個嘅時候讀過夜學。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 duk6 gwo3 je6 hok6.
english_sentence: When I was little, I attended night school.

cantonese_sentence: 佢成日做夜遊鶴，好晏都唔瞓覺。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zou6 je6 jau4 hok6, hou2 aan3 dou1 m4 fan3 gaau3.
english_sentence: He's always a night owl, he doesn't sleep until very late.

english_sentence: I really like eating fried rice with Chinese sausage.

cantonese_sentence: 你著條臘腸褲，睇落好瘦喎!
jyutping_sentence: nei5 zoek3 tiu4 laap6 cheung2 fu3, tai2 lok6 hou2 sau3 wo3!
english_sentence: Wearing those skinny jeans, you look really slim!

english_sentence: Don't trip someone here!

english: Scabby; mangy (used to describe skin condition, often on animals)
cantonese_sentence: 佢隻狗生咗好多瘌痢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zek3 gau2 sang1 zo2 hou2 do1 laat6 lei2.

cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都迾喺隊尾。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 le5 hai2 deoi2 mei1.
english_sentence: He always trails behind at the back of the line.

cantonese_sentence: 佢用針剌穿個氣球。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jung6 zam1 laat3 cyun1 go3 hei3 kau4.
english_sentence: He used a needle to prick the balloon.

cantonese_sentence: 你間房好邋遢呀!
jyutping_sentence: nei5 gaan1 fong2 hou2 laap6 taap3 aa3!
english_sentence: Your room is so messy!

english: Toss salad (usually Yu Sheng, particularly eaten during Chinese New Year)
cantonese_sentence: 我哋今晚食撈鬆慶祝新年。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 sik6 lou1 sung1 hing3 zuk1 san1 nin4.
english_sentence: We are eating Yu Sheng tonight to celebrate the New Year.

english: To stir, to mix up; to interfere.
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好撈攪人哋做嘢啦。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lou1 gaau2 jan4 dei6 zou6 je5 laa1.
english_sentence: Don't interfere with other people's work.

english: To mix (something loose), to stir something up (can imply mixing carelessly)
cantonese_sentence: 我撈鬆啲沙律畀你食啦。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lou1 sung1 di1 saa1 lat1 bei2 nei5 sik6 laa1.
english_sentence: I'll mix the salad for you to eat.

cantonese_sentence: 我捩親隻腳
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai6 can1 zek3 goek3
english_sentence: I twisted my foot.

cantonese_sentence: 佢嬲到擰都唔捩轉頭就走咗。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 nau1 dou3 ning6 dou1 m4 lai6 zyun2 tau4 zau6 zau2 zo2.
english_sentence: He was so angry that he didn't even turn his head back before leaving.

english: To pull a face, grimace (often in pain or displeasure)
cantonese_sentence: 佢撞到個頭，即刻捩歪面。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zong6 dou2 go3 tau4, zik1 hak1 le4 wai1 min6.
english_sentence: He bumped his head and immediately pulled a face.

cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢好捩手㗎，成日整爛嘢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 hou2 lai6 sau2 gaa3, seng4 jat6 zing2 laan6 je5.
english_sentence: He's very clumsy at doing things, he always breaks things.

cantonese_sentence: 件事好捩橫折曲，我搞唔掂呀。
jyutping_sentence: gin6 si6 hou2 lit6 waang4 zit3 kuk1, ngo5 gaau2 m4 dim6 aa3.
english_sentence: This matter is so complicated, I can't handle it.

english: To be serious; to get real
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好以為我同你講笑，今次我係嚟真㗎。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 ji5 wai4 ngo5 tung4 nei5 gong2 siu3, gam1 ci3 ngo5 hai6 lai4 zan1 gaa3.
english_sentence: Don't think I'm joking with you, I'm being serious this time.

cantonese_sentence: 你幾時嚟香港呀？
jyutping_sentence: nei5 gei2 si4 lai4 hoeng1 gong2 aa3?
english_sentence: When are you coming to Hong Kong?

english: To be in time/to make it in time
cantonese_sentence: 我哋而家出發都嚟得切嘅。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji4 ga1 ceot1 faat3 dou1 lai4 dak1 cit3 ge3.
english_sentence: We can still make it in time if we leave now.

english: Emphasizes that something is the case, a common expression implying "it is so", "that's how it is", or "it's meant to be this way". Often used to explain something.
cantonese_sentence: 我哋係咁樣做嘢嚟㗎
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai6 gam2 joeng2 zou6 je5 lai4 gaa3
english_sentence: This is how we do things around here.

english: Recently, soon, in the near future
cantonese_sentence: 我嚟緊頭會去香港。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lai4 gan2 tau2 wui5 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2.
english_sentence: I'm going to Hong Kong soon.

english: Too late to make it / Won't be able to arrive in time
cantonese_sentence: 我趕時間，驚嚟唔切呀！
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, geng1 lai4 m4 cit3 aa3!
english_sentence: I'm in a rush, I'm afraid I won't make it in time!

cantonese_sentence: 我下個禮拜去香港
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 haa6 go3 lai5 baai3 heoi3 hoeng1 gong2
english_sentence: I'm going to Hong Kong next week.

cantonese_sentence: 我買咗張禮券送俾朋友做生日禮物。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maai5 zo2 zoeng1 lai5 gyun3 sung3 bei2 pang4 jau5 zou6 saang1 jat6 lai5 mat6.
english_sentence: I bought a gift certificate as a birthday present for my friend.

cantonese_sentence: 我想用呢張禮券買嘢。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 yung6 ni1 zoeng1 lai5 gyun3 maai5 je5.
english_sentence: I want to use this gift certificate to buy something.

cantonese_sentence: 件衫條禮衣邊好靚呀
jyutping_sentence: gin6 saam1 tiu4 lai5 ji1 bin1 hou2 leng3 aa3
english_sentence: The lace edging on this shirt is very pretty!

cantonese_sentence: 做人要有禮義廉，先至會得到人哋嘅尊重。
jyutping_sentence: zou6 jan4 jiu3 jau5 lai5 ji6 lim4, sin1 zi3 wui5 dak1 dou3 jan4 dei6 ge3 zyun1 zung6.
english_sentence: To be a person, you must have decency, righteousness, and integrity, then you will gain people's respect.

cantonese_sentence: 佢好講禮數㗎，對長輩好尊重。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 gong2 lai5 sou3 gaa3, deoi3 zoeng2 bui3 hou2 zyun1 zung6.
english_sentence: He/She has very good manners, and is very respectful to elders.

english: to poke lightly with a finger; to dab (e.g., with a medicine)
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好用手指𧢝我塊面呀！
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 yung6 sau2 zi2 lam4 ngo5 faai3 min6 aa3!
english_sentence: Don't poke my face with your finger!

cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意食荔枝乾，因為佢甜甜地好味道。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 sik6 lai6 zi1 gon1, jan1 wai6 keoi5 tim4 tim4 dei2 hou2 mei6 dou6.
english_sentence: I like to eat dried lychee, because it's sweet and delicious.

english: Lipu Taro (a specific type of large, flavorful taro from Lipu, Guangxi, China)
cantonese_sentence: 今晚我哋煲荔浦芋頭炆腩肉嚟食。

english_sentence: Tonight we will cook braised pork belly with Lipu taro for dinner.

cantonese_sentence: 呢套戲好勵志，睇完令人好有動力。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 tou3 hei3 hou2 lai6 zi3, tai2 jyun4 ling6 jan4 hou2 jau5 dung6 lik6.
english_sentence: This movie is very inspirational; after watching it, it makes people feel very motivated.

cantonese_sentence: 我今日想食個叉燒例飯。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 soeng2 sik6 go3 caa1 siu1 lai6 faan6.
english_sentence: Today, I want to eat a BBQ pork set meal.

cantonese_sentence: 公司有好多例規要跟。
jyutping_sentence: gung1 si1 jau5 hou2 do1 lai6 kwai1 jiu3 gan1.
english_sentence: The company has many rules and regulations to follow.

cantonese_sentence: 今日例牌飲凍檸茶。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 lai6 paai4 jam2 dung3 ning2 caa4.
english_sentence: Today I'll have my usual iced lemon tea.

english: Signature dish; house specialty; a dish that is always or often ordered.
cantonese_sentence: 你嚟到呢間餐廳，例牌菜一定要試吓佢哋嘅招牌燒鵝。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 lai4 dou3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1, lai6 paai4 coi3 jat1 ding6 jiu3 si3 haa5 keoi5 dei6 ge3 ziu1 paai4 siu1 ngo2.
english_sentence: When you come to this restaurant, you definitely have to try their signature roast goose, it's the house specialty.

english: Soup of the day / Daily soup
cantonese_sentence: 今日嘅例湯係西洋菜湯。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 ge3 lai6 tong1 hai6 sai1 joeng4 coi3 tong1.
english_sentence: Today's soup of the day is watercress soup.

english: To cough up phlegm/phlegm coming loose

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 lat1 zo2 ho2 do1 kat1 aa3.
english_sentence: He coughed up a lot of phlegm today.

english: to tighten; to rein in; to strangle
cantonese_sentence: 勒緊條褲頭帶
jyutping_sentence: lak6 gan2 tiu4 fu3 tau4 daai3
english_sentence: Tighten your belt.

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 teng1 keoi5 di1 lam1 go1.
english_sentence: I really like listening to his/her love songs.

cantonese_sentence: 考試肥佬，佢即刻冧晒篷頭。
jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 fei4 lou2, keui5 zik1 haak1 lam1 saai3 pung4 tau4.

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 keoi5 ge3 tim4 jin4 mat6 jyu5 lam1 dou3 wan4 wan4 dei2.

jyutping_sentence: gaan1 pou3 tau2 gaau2 gaau2 haa5 zau6 lam1 dong3 laa3.

jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 lam4 lam4 sam4 sam4, zap1 faan1 hou2 keoi5 laa1.

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zan1 hai6 hou2 lam4 sam4 gaa3!

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 lam4 gap1 lam4 mong4 gon2 faan1 uk1 kei2.

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 zou6 lam4 gei3 gaa3

english_sentence: We only found out we had to submit the report at the last minute, it's really stressing us out (literally, our heads are getting bigger).

english: Bedwetting before dawn/last-minute failure; failing at the very end
cantonese_sentence: 佢考試之前唔溫書，臨天光賴尿，最後肥佬。

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sai3 go3 ge3 zan6 zyu6 gwo3 lam4 uk1.

jyutping_sentence: m4 ho2 sing4 jat6 pok1 ngo5 laa1, hou2 han4 aa3!
english_sentence: Don't keep poking me, it's ticklish!

english: To crowd/push (someone) with a lot of people.
cantonese_sentence: 唔好㨆人山，排隊啦！
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 on1 jan4 saan1, paai4 deoi2 laa1!
english_sentence: Don't crowd/push, line up!

english: To swoon, to be totally smitten, to fall deeply in love (usually used for infatuation)
cantonese_sentence: 佢冧咗佢個英文老師。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lam1 zo2 keoi5 go3 jing1 man4 lou5 si1.

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan1 daa2 maa4 zoek3, lin4 lam1 zong1 saam1 ci3!
english_sentence: I played mahjong tonight and won three consecutive rounds!

english: To fondle, to fiddle with, to mess with, to tease (often used in a vulgar or playful way)

jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 lan2 ngo5 laa1!

cantonese_sentence: 佢掕住個袋行路
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 laang6 zyu6 go3 doi2 haang4 lou6
english_sentence: He/She is carrying the bag and walking.

cantonese_sentence: 呢個盒嘅棱好尖。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 hap6 ge3 ling4 hou2 zim1.
english_sentence: The edge of this box is very sharp.

cantonese_sentence: 我戴咗頂笠去遮太陽。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daai3 zo2 ding2 lap1 heoi3 ze1 tai3 joeng4.
english_sentence: I put on a hat to block the sun.

english: To remember something well, to have something deeply ingrained in one's memory.
cantonese_sentence: 我細個嗰陣時嘅經歷已經笠記喺我腦海入面喇。

english: To flatter someone excessively; to butter someone up.
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日笠高帽喇，我唔會加你人工㗎。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 lap1 gou1 mou2 laa3, ngo5 m4 wui5 gaa1 nei5 yan4 gung1 gaa3.
english_sentence: Stop trying to flatter me all the time, I won't give you a raise.

cantonese_sentence: 今日凍凍地，記得着多件笠衫啊。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 dung3 dung3 dei2, gei3 dak1 zoek3 do1 gin6 lap1 saam1 aa3.
english_sentence: It's a bit chilly today, remember to put on a sweater/jacket.

cantonese_sentence: 間房立立亂，執好佢啦！
jyutping_sentence: gaan1 fong2 lap1 lap1 lyun6, zap1 hou2 keoi5 laa1!
english_sentence: The room is a mess, tidy it up!

english: Messy; disorganized; haphazard; doing things without thinking
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁立亂擺啲嘢啦！
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 lap6 lyun6 baai2 di1 je5 laa1!
english_sentence: Don't just put things down so haphazardly!

cantonese_sentence: 佢立時間就跑咗出去。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 lap1 si4 gaan3 zau6 paau2 zo2 chut1 heoi3.
english_sentence: He ran out immediately.

cantonese_sentence: 佢朝朝起身都甩好多痰。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ziu1 ziu1 hei2 san1 dou1 lat1 hou2 do1 taam4.
english_sentence: He coughs up a lot of phlegm every morning when he gets up.

english_sentence: I dislocated my joint playing football.

cantonese_sentence: 佢打交打到甩下巴。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 daa2 gaau1 daa2 dou3 lat1 haa5 baa1.
english_sentence: He dislocated his jaw fighting.

english: To miss an appointment/commitment, to be late
cantonese_sentence: 我唔好意思，唔記得咗今日約咗你，甩咗期。

english: To rip off, to swindle, to cheat someone out of money.

cantonese_sentence: 我略略唔舒服。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 loek6 loek6 m4 syu1 fuk6.
english_sentence: I feel a little bit unwell.

english: to lick (usually something with flavour, like a lollipop, or the last bits of something delicious)
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都噒雪條。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 lin1 syut3 tiu2.
english_sentence: He always licks lollipops.

english: To try to get a discount by picking at flaws; to be overly critical to drive down the price.

english_sentence: Don't keep picking at flaws to get a lower price, this shirt is already very cheap!

cantonese_sentence: 呢架車嘅輪胎漏氣喇。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaa3 ce1 ge3 leon4 taai1 lau6 hei3 laa3.
english_sentence: This car's tire is leaking air.

english: To wait in line, to be on a waiting list
cantonese_sentence: 我哋喺度輪候咗成個鐘頭，都未有位。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 hai2 dou6 leon4 hau6 zo2 sing4 go3 zung1 tau4, dou1 mei6 jau5 wai2.
english_sentence: We've been waiting in line here for an hour, and we still don't have a seat.

english: To take turns, to rotate (duties, tasks, etc.)
cantonese_sentence: 我哋輪籌洗碗。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 leon4 cau4 sai2 wun2.
english_sentence: We take turns washing dishes.

cantonese_sentence: 佢好論盡，成日跌嘢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 leon6 zeon6, seng4 jat6 dit3 je5.
english_sentence: He/She is very clumsy, always dropping things.

cantonese_sentence: 佢做嘢論論盡盡，成日都搞錯嘢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 zou6 je5 leon6 leon6 zeon6 zeon6, seng4 jat6 dou1 gaau2 co3 je5.
english_sentence: He/She is careless at work and always messes things up.

cantonese_sentence: 佢想做個量地官，周圍去勘察地皮。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 zou6 go3 loeng4 dei6 gun1, zau1 wai4 heoi3 ham1 caat3 dei6 pei4.
english_sentence: He wants to be a land surveyor, going around surveying land.

cantonese_sentence: 出咗糧未呀?
jyutping_sentence: ceot1 zo2 loeng4 mei6 a3?
english_sentence: Have you received your salary yet?

cantonese_sentence: 佢份糧係咪會喺糧簿度出㗎？
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 loeng4 hai6 mai1 wui5 hai2 loeng4 bou2 dou6 ceot1 gaa3?
english_sentence: Is his/her salary paid out through the payroll ledger?

cantonese_sentence: 我要交糧單俾銀行申請按揭。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 jiu3 gaau1 loeng4 daan1 bei2 ngan4 hong4 san1 ching2 on3 gaai2.
english_sentence: I need to submit my payslip to the bank to apply for a mortgage.

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 loeng4 kei4 hai6 mui5 jyut6 mei5
english_sentence: Our company's payday is at the end of each month.

english: End of the month (when salary/money is running low)

jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 loeng4 mei1, ngo5 dei6 sik6 min6 baau1 syun3 laa1.
english_sentence: It's the end of the month, let's just eat bread.

english: Boss, leader, someone who provides resources or support. Often used humorously or ironically.
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日淨係識得攞著數，根本就唔係一個好糧頭。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zing6 hai6 sik1 dak1 lo2 zoek6 sou3, gan1 bun2 zau6 m4 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 loeng4 tau4.
english_sentence: He only knows how to take advantage of things and isn't a good leader at all.

english: Cool and refreshing (often describing a feeling or sensation)
cantonese_sentence: 沖完涼之後，感覺好涼浸浸。
jyutping_sentence: chung1 jyun4 loeng4 zi1 hau6, gam2 gok3 hou2 loeng4 zam3 zam3.
english_sentence: After showering, I feel very cool and refreshed.

english: Glass jelly (a type of cold, translucent noodle-like jelly)
cantonese_sentence: 我想食碗涼粉。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 wun2 loeng4 fan2.
english_sentence: I want to eat a bowl of glass jelly.

cantonese_sentence: 我唔鍾意食涼瓜，因為太苦。

english_sentence: I don't like to eat bitter melon because it's too bitter.

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 sai3 go3 ge3 si4 hau6 seng4 jat6 sik6 loeng4 gwo2.
english_sentence: When I was a kid, I often ate candied fruit.

cantonese_sentence: 今日天氣好涼氣呀!
jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 loeng4 hei3 aa3!
english_sentence: The weather is so cool today!

english_sentence: Drink a glass of cool water first, my throat is completely dry.

jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 loeng4 song2 aa3!
english_sentence: The weather is so cool and refreshing today!

cantonese_sentence: 飲返杯涼茶降下火先。
jyutping_sentence: yam2 faan1 bui1 loeng4 caa4 gong3 haa5 fo2 sin1.
english_sentence: Drink a cup of herbal tea to cool down first.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋放工之後去涼茶鋪飲杯廿四味啦。

english: Certificate of Good Conduct, police clearance certificate

english_sentence: Having obtained a Certificate of Good Conduct means you have no criminal record.

jyutping_sentence: loeng5 zai2 ye4 hai2 gung1 jyun2 tek3 bo1.
english_sentence: The father and son are playing football in the park.

jyutping: loeng5 zai2 je4 bou3 gaai1 jam1 dai6 dai6 ping4 on1

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zai2 je4 seng4 jat6 jat1 cai4 heoi3 jam2 caa4, zan1 hai6 jing3 zo2 geoi3 "loeng5 zai2 je4 bou3 gaai1 jam1 dai6 dai6 ping4 on1".
english_sentence: Those two, father and son, always go for dim sum together. It really embodies the saying "Like father, like son, singing carols – a wish for peace and safety in every generation." (Meaning they are very close and share similar traits/activities, reflecting a good familial bond that hopefully continues through generations).

english: mother and son (referring to a pair, usually implying a close relationship)

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 zai2 naa2 hou2 gwai2 sweet gaa3!

english_sentence: I want two portions of siu mai.

jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 nei5 gong2 loeng5 geoi3?
english_sentence: Why don't you say a few words?

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 loeng5 gung1 po4 hou2 yan1 oi3.

english_sentence: They use mules to transport goods.

jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 daa2 leoi4 gung1, gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1 aa3!
english_sentence: Tomorrow there's going to be thunder, remember to bring an umbrella!

jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 faan1 gung1 hou2 leoi6 aa3!
english_sentence: I'm so tired from work today!

jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam2 joeng2 dou2 cin2 faat3, ci4 zou2 maai5 ding6 gun1 caai4 gwat6 ding6 tam5 gaa3 laa1.
english_sentence: The way he gambles, he might as well buy a coffin and dig a grave soon. (He's doomed.)

cantonese_sentence: 買定離手，開大細喇！
jyutping_sentence: maai5 ding6 lei4 sau2, hoi1 daai6 sai3 laa1!
english_sentence: No more bets, the dice game is starting!

cantonese_sentence: 唔好再買鐘啦，快啲做完佢！
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 maai5 zung1 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 geoi1!
english_sentence: Stop stalling and finish it quickly!

english: To buy flowers to wear (often implying frivolous spending)
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日買花戴，真係好識享受。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maai5 faa1 daai3, zan1 hai6 hou2 sik1 hoeng2 sau6.
english_sentence: She often buys flowers to wear, she really knows how to enjoy life.

english: to buy out, to acquire completely (a business, idea, etc.), to bribe someone into silence/submission
cantonese_sentence: 佢想買起間公司。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 maai5 hei2 gaan1 gung1 si1.
english_sentence: He wants to buy out the company.

english: Shell company acquisition (buying an existing company with a stock market listing)
cantonese_sentence: 佢哋公司想買殼上市。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 gung1 si1 soeng2 maai5 hok3 soeng5 si5.
english_sentence: Their company wants to acquire a shell company to go public.

english: Play it safe; buy it to be safe
cantonese_sentence: 為咗唔想中病毒, 我哋買定多啲口罩買佢怕啦.
jyutping_sentence: wai4 zo2 m4 soeng2 zung3 beng6 duk6, ngo5 dei6 maai5 ding6 do1 di1 hau2 zaau3 maai5 keoi5 paa3 laa1.
english_sentence: To avoid getting infected, let's buy some more masks just to be safe.

cantonese_sentence: 佢哋問我哋攞買路錢，唔俾就唔俾我哋過。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 man6 ngo5 dei6 lo2 maai5 lou6 cin2, m4 bei2 zau6 m4 bei2 ngo5 dei6 gwo3.
english_sentence: They asked us for protection money, if we didn't give it, they wouldn't let us pass.

cantonese_sentence: 我聽日會去跑馬地買馬。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 ting1 jat6 wui5 heoi3 paau2 maa5 dei6 maai5 maa5.
english_sentence: I'm going to Happy Valley tomorrow to bet on horses.

cantonese_sentence: 我想放個買盤買入騰訊。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 fong3 go3 maai5 pun4 maai5 jap6 tang4 seon3.
english_sentence: I want to place a buy order to buy Tencent shares.

cantonese_sentence: 我朋友喺名牌店做買手，成日飛去歐洲睇新款。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai2 ming4 paai4 dim3 zou6 maai5 sau2, seng4 jat6 fei1 heoi3 au1 zau1 tai2 san1 fun2.
english_sentence: My friend works as a buyer at a luxury brand store and flies to Europe all the time to see new designs.

english: Increasingly rare; diminishing and soon to be gone.
cantonese_sentence: 依家啲傳統手工藝買少見少，真係要好好珍惜。
jyutping_sentence: ji1 gaa1 di1 cyun4 tung2 sau2 gung1 ngai6 maai5 siu2 gin3 siu2, zan1 hai6 jiu3 hou2 hou2 zan1 sik1.
english_sentence: Nowadays, traditional handicrafts are becoming increasingly rare, we really need to cherish them.

english: To bribe, to buy someone off
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日買水，所以先可以咁順利。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maai5 seoi2, so2 ji5 sin1 ho2 ji5 gam3 seon6 lei6.
english_sentence: He's always bribing people, that's why things have been so smooth for him.

english: To buy a seat (usually referring to paying for a seat in a desired school/program, circumventing regular admissions procedures)
cantonese_sentence: 佢哋買位入名校
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 maai5 wai2 jap6 ming4 haau6
english_sentence: They bought their way into a prestigious school.

cantonese_sentence: 我想賣咗我部車。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai6 zo2 ngo5 bou6 ce1.
english_sentence: I want to sell my car.

english: To show respect/to give face (to someone)
cantonese_sentence: 你阿爸喺度，俾啲面光佢啦！
jyutping_sentence: nei5 aa3 baa1 hai2 dou6, bei2 di1 min6 gwong1 keoi5 laa1!
english_sentence: Your dad is here, give him some face!

cantonese_sentence: 佢以前細個成日喺街邊賣報紙。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ji5 cin4 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 bin1 maai6 bou3 zi2.
english_sentence: When he was young, he often sold newspapers on the street.

english: Throw in extra freebies; offer a really good deal to clear stock or attract customers.
cantonese_sentence: 今日間舖頭賣大包，買一送一呀！
jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 gaan1 pou3 tau4 maai6 daai6 baau1, maai5 jat1 sung3 jat1 aa3!
english_sentence: The shop is offering a great deal today, buy one get one free!

english: Selling point; a feature or aspect of something that makes it desirable
cantonese_sentence: 呢個樓盤嘅賣點係交通方便。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 lau4 pun4 ge3 maai6 dim2 hai6 gaau1 tung1 fong1 bin6.
english_sentence: The selling point of this housing estate is its convenient transportation.

cantonese_sentence: 我阿婆成日都賣當借啲金器
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 aa3 po4 seng4 jat6 dou1 maai6 dong3 ze3 di1 gam1 hei3
english_sentence: My grandma often pawns her gold jewelry.

cantonese_sentence: 佢哋成日攞啲賣剩蔗去餵牛。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 seng4 jat6 lo2 di1 maai6 sing6 ze3 heoi3 wai6 ngau4.
english_sentence: They often take the leftover sugarcane to feed the cows.

english: Unwanted/unsold item, typically an unattractive or unwanted woman who is past marriageable age.
cantonese_sentence: 佢都變咗賣剩腳喇, 仲唔快啲揾個好人家嫁咗佢？
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 bin3 zo2 maai6 sing6 goek3 laa3, zung6 m4 faai3 di1 wan2 go3 hou2 jan4 gaa1 gaa3 zo2 keoi5?
english_sentence: She's practically an old maid now, shouldn't she hurry and find a good family to marry into?

english: To ruin/tarnish a reputation; to damage a brand's image.
cantonese_sentence: 唔好再咁做啦，你咁樣係賣招牌呀！
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoi3 gam2 zou6 laa1, nei5 gam2 joeng2 hai6 maai6 ziu1 paai4 aa3!
english_sentence: Don't do that anymore, you're ruining the reputation!

english: To sell someone into forced labor/indentured servitude (literally "to sell piglets")
cantonese_sentence: 佢哋呃咗好多人去外國賣豬仔。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ngaak1 zo2 hou2 do1 jan4 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3 maai6 zyu1 zai2.
english_sentence: They tricked many people into going abroad to be sold into forced labor.

cantonese_sentence: 呢間廠啲嘢賣埠賣得好好。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 cong2 di1 je5 maai6 fau6 maai6 dak1 hou2 hou2.
english_sentence: This factory's products are exporting very well.

cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳嘅叉燒係我嘅賣飛佛。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 can1 teng1 ge3 caa1 siu1 hai6 ngo5 ge3 maai6 fei1 fo4.
english_sentence: This restaurant's char siu (barbecue pork) is my favourite.

english: To confess publicly with the intention of gaining attention or sympathy (often used sarcastically or negatively)
cantonese_sentence: 佢又喺社交媒體賣告白，想博人同情。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau6 hai2 se5 giao1 mui4 tai2 maai6 gou3 baak6, soeng2 bok3 jan4 tung4 cing4.
english_sentence: He's selling his confession on social media again, trying to gain sympathy.

cantonese_sentence: 佢喺鄉下賣穀種維生。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 hoeng1 haa6 maai6 guk1 zung2 wai4 sang1.
english_sentence: He makes a living selling grain seeds in the countryside.

english: To be dead; literally "to sell salted fish" (euphemism for death)
cantonese_sentence: 佢都賣咗鹹魚好耐喇。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dou1 maai6 zo2 haam4 yu2 hou2 noi6 laa3.
english_sentence: He's been dead for quite a while.

english: to die; to kick the bucket (euphemism). Literally: "to buy salted duck eggs." Salted duck eggs are a traditional funeral offering.
cantonese_sentence: 佢琴日買咗鹹鴨蛋喇.
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 kam4 jat6 maai5 zo2 haam4 aap3 daan2 laa3.
english_sentence: He passed away yesterday.

english: To sweet-talk, to flatter, to say flattering things (often for personal gain)
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日都對老細賣口乖，想升職。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 dou1 deoi3 lou5 sai3 maai6 hau2 gwaai1, soeng2 sing1 zik1.
english_sentence: He always sweet-talks the boss, hoping to get promoted.

jyutping: maai6 jyu2 lou2 sai2 san1 — mou5 saai3 sing1 hei3
english: Fishmonger washing himself - no more fishy smell (gone is the fishy smell)
cantonese_sentence: This phrase is a simile, meaning someone has changed their behavior or appearance so much that they've lost their original characteristics, often implying a whitewashing or attempt to hide their past.
jyutping_sentence: 佢而家做咗律師，真係賣魚佬洗身——冇晒腥氣，完全睇唔出以前係個MK仔。
english_sentence: keoi5 ji4 gaa1 zou6 zo2 leot6 si1, zan1 hai6 maai6 jyu2 lou2 sai2 san1 — mou5 saai3 sing1 hei3, jyun4 cyun4 tai2 m4 ceot1 ji5 cin4 hai6 go3 MK zai2.

cantonese_sentence: 聽日學校賣旗，記得捐錢啊！
jyutping_sentence: ting1 jat6 hok6 haau6 maai6 kei4, gei3 dak1 gyun1 cin2 aa3!
english_sentence: Tomorrow is flag selling day at school, remember to donate some money!

english: To slack off, to be lazy (especially pretending to be, or playfully suggesting laziness)
cantonese_sentence: 咪再賣懶啦，快啲做完啲功課佢啦！
jyutping_sentence: mai5 zoi3 maai6 laan5 laa1, faai3 di1 zou6 jyun4 di1 gung1 fo3 keoi5 laa1!
english_sentence: Stop slacking off, finish your homework quickly!

english: To ditch, to abandon, to sell out someone
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日賣甩啲朋友自己去玩
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maai6 lat1 di1 pang4 jau5 zi6 gei2 heoi3 waan2
english_sentence: He often ditches his friends and goes to play by himself.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋聽日去學校嘅賣物會度買嘢啦。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ting1 jat6 heoi3 hok6 haau6 ge3 maai6 mat6 wui2 dou6 maai5 je5 laa1.
english_sentence: Let's go to the school's bazaar tomorrow to buy things.

english: To perform martial arts for money/to show off martial arts skills
cantonese_sentence: 佢喺街頭賣武，希望賺啲錢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 tau4 maai6 mou5, hei1 mong6 zaan6 di1 cin2.
english_sentence: He's performing martial arts on the street, hoping to earn some money.

cantonese_sentence: 間公司準備賣盤。
jyutping_sentence: gaan1 gung1 si1 zeon2 bei6 maai6 pun4.
english_sentence: The company is preparing for a business sale.

english: To try and be impressive or show off one's abilities (often in a way that is seen as trying too hard or being boastful). Literally "selling raw lotus root."
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺老闆面前賣生藕，想升職。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 lou5 baan2 min6 cin4 maai6 saang1 ngau5, soeng2 sing1 zik1.
english_sentence: He always tries to show off in front of the boss, hoping to get a promotion.

english: Presentation (specifically of food, but can be more broadly used for visual appeal)
cantonese_sentence: 呢間餐廳啲嘢食賣相好好，但係味道就麻麻哋。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 di1 je5 sik6 maai6 soeng3 hou2 hou2, daan6 hai6 mei6 dou6 zau6 maa4 maa4 dei2.
english_sentence: The food in this restaurant has a great presentation, but the taste is just so-so.

english: to split open, to open wide
cantonese_sentence: 擘大個口嚟笑啦！
jyutping_sentence: maak3 daai6 go3 hau2 lai4 siu3 laa1!
english_sentence: Open your mouth wide and laugh!

jyutping: maak3 daai6 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1
english: All mouth and trousers; all talk and no action; all show and no substance.
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日擘大口得個窿，講就天下無敵，做就無能為力。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 seng4 jat6 maak3 daai6 hau2 dak1 go3 lung1, gong2 zau6 tin1 haa6 mou4 dik1, zou6 zau6 mou4 nang4 wai4 lik6.
english_sentence: He's always all mouth and no trousers, good at talking but unable to actually do anything.

jyutping: maak3 daai6 ngaan5 gong2 daai6 waa6
english: To lie through one's teeth (literally: to open wide eyes and tell lies)
cantonese_sentence: 你擘大眼講大話，明明就係你偷食咗嗰件蛋糕！
jyutping_sentence: nei5 maak3 daai6 ngaan5 gong2 daai6 waa6, ming4 ming4 zau6 hai6 nei5 tau1 sik6 zo2 go2 gin6 daan6 gou1!
english_sentence: You're lying through your teeth, it was clearly you who secretly ate that piece of cake!

english: To rub the sleep out of your eyes / To wake up and clear the sleep from your eyes
cantonese_sentence: 你朝朝起身都擘開眼屎先嘅？
jyutping_sentence: nei5 ziu1 ziu1 hei2 san1 dou1 maak3 hoi1 ngaan5 si2 sin1 ge3?
english_sentence: Do you always rub the sleep out of your eyes first thing in the morning?

english: To fall out (with someone), to have a falling-out
cantonese_sentence: 我哋因為少少事就擘面，真係唔抵。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 jan1 wai6 siu2 siu2 si6 zau6 maak3 min6, zan1 hai6 m4 dai2.
english_sentence: We fell out over something small, it's really not worth it.

english: to dip, to dunk, to soak (in liquid)
cantonese_sentence: 唔好將啲薯條𢺳落茄汁度
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 zoeng1 di1 syu4 tiu4 dim6 lok6 ke4 zap1 dou6
english_sentence: Don't dip the fries in the ketchup.

cantonese_sentence: 佢好𢺳雞，成日跟住條仔。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hou2 caa2 gai1, seng4 jat6 gan1 zeoi6 tiu4 zai2.
english_sentence: She's so clingy, always following her boyfriend.

english: To freeload, leech off, or piggyback on something or someone; to be carried along by someone else's efforts.
cantonese_sentence: 佢成日喺度𢺳車邊，乜都唔做！
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 sing4 jat6 hai2 dou6 caa4 ce1 bin1, mat1 dou1 m4 zou6!
english_sentence: He's always freeloading here, doing nothing!

cantonese_sentence: 你慢下手做嘢啦，唔使咁急嘅。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 maan6 haa6 sau2 zou6 je5 laa1, m4 sai2 gam3 gap1 ge3.
english_sentence: Slow down with your work, no need to rush so much.

cantonese_sentence: 唔好用蠻力，會整壞嘅。
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 jung6 maan4 lik6, wui5 zing2 waai6 ge3.
english_sentence: Don't use brute force, you'll break it.

cantonese_sentence: 佢個人好蠻橫，成日要人哋聽佢話。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 maan4 waang6, seng4 jat6 jiu3 jan4 dei6 ting1 keoi5 waa6.
english_sentence: He is a very unreasonable person, always wanting people to listen to him.

cantonese_sentence: 晚黑唔好周圍去啦，危險嘅。
jyutping_sentence: maan5 hak1 m4 hou2 zau1 wai4 heoi3 laa1, ngai4 him2 ge3.
english_sentence: Don't go wandering around at night, it's dangerous.

cantonese_sentence: 我每晚都會搽晚霜。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 mui5 maan5 dou1 wui5 caa4 maan5 soeng1.
english_sentence: I apply night cream every night.

cantonese_sentence: 我晚頭黑喺屋企食飯。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 maan5 tau4 hak1 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6 faan6.
english_sentence: I'm having dinner at home this evening.

cantonese_sentence: 今年啲晚禾收成唔好。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 nin4 di1 maan5 wo4 sau1 sing4 m4 hou2.
english_sentence: This year's late rice crop harvest isn't good.

cantonese_sentence: 你行慢啲啦!
jyutping_sentence: nei5 haang4 maan6 di1 laa1!
english_sentence: You walk slower!

cantonese_sentence: 你行慢啲啦!
jyutping_sentence: nei5 haang4 maan6 di1 laa1!
english_sentence: Walk slower, please!

english: Take your time/Speak slowly/Let's talk later
cantonese_sentence: 你哋慢慢講，我唔阻你哋啦。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 dei6 maan6 maan6 gong2, ngo5 m4 zo2 nei5 dei6 laa1.
english_sentence: You all take your time, I won't disturb you.

english: Haste makes waste/Slow work produces fine work
cantonese_sentence: 我哋慢工出細貨，確保呢個項目嘅質量。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 maan6 gung1 ceot1 sai3 fo3, kok3 bou2 ni1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 zat1 loeng6.
english_sentence: We're taking our time to ensure the quality of this project.

english: Walk slowly, take your time walking
cantonese_sentence: 你唔使急, 慢慢行啦。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 sai2 gap1, maan6 maan2 haang4 laa1.
english_sentence: You don't need to rush, take your time walking.

english: To slowly peel/pluck/pinch off (usually small things)
cantonese_sentence: 佢慢慢搣緊啲提子皮
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan6 maan2 mit1 gan2 di1 tai4 zi2 pei4
english_sentence: He/She is slowly peeling the grape skins.

cantonese_sentence: 前面有學校，慢駛啦！
jyutping_sentence: cin4 min6 jau5 hok6 haau6, maan6 sai2 laa1!
english_sentence: There's a school ahead, drive slowly!

english: Myriad responsibilities/problems, I've got it/I'm on it (conveys a sense of taking responsibility for a large task or problem)
cantonese_sentence: 呢鑊嘢咁多嘢搞，不過萬大有我，你哋放心！
jyutping_sentence: ni1 wok6 je5 gam3 do1 je5 gaau2, bat1 gwo3 maan6 daai6 jau5 ngo5, nei5 dei6 fong3 sam1!
english_sentence: This matter has so much to deal with, but don't worry, I'm on it!

english: Wan (character in Mahjong, numbering from one to nine)
cantonese_sentence: 我打咗隻八萬子
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 daa2 zo2 zek3 baat3 maan6 zi2
english_sentence: I discarded an eight Wan.

cantonese_sentence: 可唔可以借個萬字夾俾我呀？
jyutping_sentence: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 ze3 go3 maan6 zi6 gaap3 bei2 ngo5 aa3?
english_sentence: Could you lend me a paperclip?

cantonese_sentence: 我頭痛，搽啲萬金油會舒服啲。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 tau4 tung3, caa4 di1 maan6 gam1 jau4 wui5 syu1 fuk6 di1.
english_sentence: I have a headache; applying some Tiger Balm will make me feel more comfortable.

english: String of flags (of different nations), bunting
cantonese_sentence: 佢間房掛滿哂萬國旗咁，好鬼熱鬧。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaan1 fong2 gwaa3 mun5 saai3 maan6 gwok3 kei4 gam2, hou2 gwai2 jit6 naau6.
english_sentence: His room is covered with strings of flags, it's very festive.

english: Versatile veteran performer; Jack-of-all-trades, master of none (often used humorously or slightly disparagingly)
cantonese_sentence: 佢乜都識啲，不過始終都係萬能老倌啫。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 mat1 dou1 sik1 di1, bat1 gwo3 chi2 chung1 dou1 hai6 maan6 nang4 lou5 gwaan1 ze1.
english_sentence: He knows a little bit of everything, but ultimately, he's just a jack-of-all-trades, master of none.

english: WD-40 (or a similar multi-purpose lubricant/penetrant spray)
cantonese_sentence: 我支萬能蘇用晒，要買過支先得。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zi1 maan6 nang4 sou1 yung6 saai3, jiu3 maai5 gwo3 zi1 sin1 dak1.
english_sentence: My can of WD-40 is all used up, I need to buy another one.

cantonese_sentence: 我想買個萬壽果煲湯。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 go3 maan6 sau6 gwo2 bou1 tong1.
english_sentence: I want to buy a papaya for soup.

english: Everything is negotiable / There's always room for discussion
cantonese_sentence: 不如大家坐低慢慢傾，萬事有商量嘛。
jyutping_sentence: bat1 jyu4 daai6 gaa1 co5 dai1 maan6 maan2 king1, maan6 si6 jau5 soeng1 loeng4 maa3.
english_sentence: Why don't we all sit down and talk it over slowly? Everything is negotiable, after all.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋今年萬聖節會去蘭桂坊慶祝。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 maan6 sing3 zit3 wui5 heoi3 laan4 gwai3 fong1 hing3 zuk1.
english_sentence: We are going to Lan Kwai Fong to celebrate Halloween this year.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋祝你萬歲萬歲萬萬歲!
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 zuk1 nei5 maan6 seoi3 maan6 seoi3 maan6 maan6 seoi3!
english_sentence: We wish you long life, long life, a long, long life!

cantonese_sentence: 條橡筋好繃呀!
jyutping_sentence: tiu4 zoeng6 gan1 hou2 baang1 aa3!

jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 mou5 mat1 je5 zou6.

english_sentence: It should be alright if it rains tomorrow (i.e., shouldn't cause too many problems).

english: Nothing much; it's nothing; no big deal

jyutping_sentence: gam1 jat6 mou5 mat1 je5 zou6.
english_sentence: I don't have much to do today.

jyutping_sentence: nei5 mai5 gwai2 hau2 keoi5 laa1, tiu4 jau2 gam3 mou5 pei4 caai4!

english: Preserved mustard greens (often fermented and salty)

english_sentence: What are you spacing out and thinking about again?

english: In an instant; in a flash; suddenly
cantonese_sentence: 佢霎時間跑咗出去。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 saap3 si3 gaan1 paau2 zo2 ceot1 heoi3.
english_sentence: He ran out in a flash.

cantonese_sentence: 啲星星熠下熠下噉
jyutping_sentence: di1 sing1 sing1 jap1 haa5 jap1 haa5 gam2
english_sentence: The stars are sparkling.

english: Overcooked (and therefore shriveled) dog head; Used to describe something overdone, messed up, or ruined due to excessive effort or time.
cantonese_sentence: 你份功課俾你改到熠熟狗頭咁，都唔知你想表達啲乜。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 fan6 gung1 fo3 bei2 nei5 gaai2 dou3 jip1 suk6 gau2 tau4 gam3, dou1 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 biu2 daat6 di1 mat1.
english_sentence: You've overdone your homework, it's a mess, and I don't even know what you're trying to express.

cantonese_sentence: 唔好殺佢!
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 saat3 keoi5!
english_sentence: Don't kill him!

english: To forfeit the deposit (on a purchase). Usually happens when backing out of a deal after already placing a deposit.
cantonese_sentence: 我驚樓市跌，寧願殺訂都唔買喇。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 geng1 lau4 si5 dit3, ning4 jyun2 saat3 ding3 dou1 m4 maai5 laa1.
english_sentence: I'm afraid the property market will fall, I'd rather forfeit the deposit than buy.

english: Right on top of you; Very imminent; To be facing an immediate threat or problem.
cantonese_sentence: 考試殺到埋身，我仲未溫習。
jyutping_sentence: haau2 si5 saat3 dou3 maai4 san1, ngo5 zung6 mei6 wan1 zaap6.
english_sentence: The exam is right on top of me, and I still haven't studied.

cantonese_sentence: 我哋間學校因為收生不足，好大機會會殺校。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 gaan1 hok6 haau6 jan1 wai6 sau1 sang1 bat1 zuk1, hou2 daai6 gei1 wui2 wui5 saat3 haau6.
english_sentence: Our school is likely to close down due to insufficient enrollment.

cantonese: 殺人放火金腰帶，修橋整路冇屍骸
jyutping: saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2 gam1 jiu1 daai3, sau1 kiu2 zing2 lou6 mou5 si1 haai4
english: Killers and arsonists are rewarded, while those who build bridges and repair roads die unnoticed and unmourned. (Essentially, doing evil gets you ahead, while doing good gets you nowhere.)
cantonese_sentence: 呢個社會殺人放火金腰帶，修橋整路冇屍骸嘅情況都幾普遍。
jyutping_sentence: ni1 go3 se5 wui2 saat3 jan4 fong3 fo2 gam1 jiu1 daai3, sau1 kiu2 zing2 lou6 mou5 si1 haai4 ge3 cing4 fong3 dou1 gei2 pou2 bin3.
english_sentence: In this society, the situation where evil gets rewarded and good deeds go unnoticed is quite common.

english: Kill an innocent person by mistake.
cantonese_sentence: 我哋唔可以冤枉好人，殺錯良民㗎。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 jyun1 wong2 hou2 jan4, saat3 co3 loeng4 man4 gaa3.
english_sentence: We can't wrongly accuse good people and kill innocent people by mistake.

cantonese_sentence: 佢架車煞唔住，撞咗埋去。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gaa3 ce1 saat3 m4 zyu6, zong6 zo2 maai4 heoi3.
english_sentence: His car couldn't stop and crashed.

cantonese_sentence: 架車太快，要煞掣先得。
jyutping_sentence: gaa3 ce1 taai3 faai3, jiu3 saat3 cai3 sin1 dak1.
english_sentence: The car is too fast, we need to brake first.

english: Very impressive, effective, impactful, especially in attracting attention or having a strong influence. Can also mean extremely delicious.
cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著到好煞食，引晒啲人望。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 dou3 hou2 saat3 sik1, jan5 saai3 di1 jan4 mong6.
english_sentence: She dressed very impressively today, attracting everyone's attention.

cantonese_sentence: 佢有啲哨牙，笑起上嚟好得意。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jau5 di1 saau3 ngaa4, siu3 hei2 soeng5 lei4 hou2 dak1 ji3.
english_sentence: He/She has a bit of buck teeth; he/she looks very cute when he/she smiles.

cantonese_sentence: 攞啲潲去餵豬。
jyutping_sentence: lo2 di1 siu3 heoi3 wai6 zyu1.
english_sentence: Take some swill to feed the pigs.

english: swill, leftover food scraps (for feeding animals)
cantonese_sentence: 啲潲水好臭，唔好行咁埋。
jyutping_sentence: di1 siu3 seoi2 hou2 cau3, m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai4.
english_sentence: That swill smells bad, don't walk so close.

english: To bring (something) along, to deliver a message/item in passing.
cantonese_sentence: 幫我捎封信俾阿媽
jyutping_sentence: bong1 ngo5 saau1 fung1 seon3 bei2 aa3 maa1
english_sentence: Help me bring this letter to my mother.

english: to glance, to peep, to take a quick look
cantonese_sentence: 佢偷偷地睄咗佢一眼。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 tau1 tau1 dei6 siu4 zo2 keoi5 jat1 ngaan5.
english_sentence: He/She secretly glanced at him/her.

cantonese_sentence: 用個篩嚟隔走啲渣。
jyutping_sentence: jung6 go3 sai1 lai4 gaak3 zau2 di1 zaa1.
english_sentence: Use a sieve to filter out the residue.

cantonese_sentence: 我想買幾件西餅返屋企。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 gei2 gin6 sai1 beng2 faan1 uk1 kei2.
english_sentence: I want to buy a few pastries to take home.

cantonese_sentence: 我今日早餐食咗西多士。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zou2 caan1 sik6 zo2 sai1 do1 si2.
english_sentence: I ate French toast for breakfast today.

cantonese_sentence: 廁所冇西紙，唔該俾啲我。
jyutping_sentence: ci3 so2 mou5 sai1 zi2, m4 goi1 bei2 di1 ngo5.
english_sentence: There's no toilet paper in the restroom, please give me some.

english: Suit (as in, a suit of clothes)
cantonese_sentence: 佢今日著咗套西裝，睇落好精神。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 taap3 sai1 zong1, tai2 lok6 hou2 zing1 san4.
english_sentence: He wore a suit today and looks very energetic.

cantonese_sentence: 我今日著咗條西裝褲返工。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 zoek3 zo2 tiu4 sai1 zong1 fu3 faan1 gung1.
english_sentence: I wore a pair of dress pants to work today.

english: Man in a suit; a well-dressed (often implying affluent or flashy) man.
cantonese_sentence: 個西裝友揸住架跑車，好威水啊！
jyutping_sentence: go3 sai1 zong1 jau5 zaa1 zyu6 gaa3 paau2 ce1, hou2 wai1 seoi2 aa3!
english_sentence: That guy in the suit, driving a sports car, is so impressive/showy!

cantonese_sentence: 攞把西瓜刀嚟切西瓜。
jyutping_sentence: lo2 baa2 sai1 gwaa1 dou1 lai4 cit3 sai1 gwaa1.
english_sentence: Bring a watermelon knife to cut the watermelon.

english: Foreigner, Westerner (often used to refer to people of European descent)
cantonese_sentence: 好多香港人都會講英文，因為好多西人嚟香港做嘢。
jyutping_sentence: hou2 do1 hoeng1 gong2 yan4 dou1 wui5 gong2 ying1 man2, yan1 wai6 hou2 do1 sai1 yan4 lei4 hoeng1 gong2 zou6 ye5.
english_sentence: Many Hong Kong people can speak English, because many foreigners come to Hong Kong to work.

cantonese_sentence: 我今日買咗啲西洋菜煲湯
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 maai5 zo2 di1 sai1 joeng4 coi3 bou1 tong1
english_sentence: I bought some watercress today to make soup.

cantonese_sentence: 我今日飲咗西洋參茶，個人精神好多。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jam2 zo2 sai1 joeng4 sam1 caa4, go3 jan4 zing1 san4 hou2 do1.
english_sentence: I drank American ginseng tea today, and I feel much more energetic.

cantonese_sentence: 我鍾意用西芹炒牛肉。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 zung1 ji3 yung6 sai1 kan4 caau2 ngau4 juk6.
english_sentence: I like to use celery to stir-fry beef.

cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食西蘭花。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 sai1 laan4 faa1.
english_sentence: I really like to eat broccoli.

cantonese_sentence: 我想食份西冷牛扒。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 fan6 sai1 lang4 ngau4 paak3.
english_sentence: I want to eat a sirloin steak.

cantonese_sentence: 我想食西米露。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 sik6 sai1 mai5 lou6.
english_sentence: I want to eat sago dessert.

cantonese_sentence: 我學緊西文，想睇得明啲西班牙電影。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hok6 gan2 sai1 man4, soeng2 tai2 dak1 ming4 di1 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 din6 ying2.
english_sentence: I'm learning Western languages (specifically Spanish), I want to be able to understand Spanish movies better.

english: Second eldest uncle (from father's side) living in the Southwest. Note: This implies that there are uncles older than him and at least one is in the Southwest.
cantonese_sentence: 我哋新年會去西南二伯父屋企拜年。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 san1 nin4 wui5 heoi3 sai1 naam4 ji6 baak3 fu2 uk1 kei2 baai3 nin4.
english_sentence: We will go to my second eldest uncle's (from my father's side) house in the Southwest for Chinese New Year greetings.

cantonese_sentence: 我今晚想睇西片。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 maan5 soeng2 tai2 sai1 pin3.
english_sentence: I want to watch a Western movie tonight.

cantonese_sentence: 太陽就嚟西斜喇。
jyutping_sentence: taai3 joeng4 zau6 lei4 sai1 ce4 laa3.
english_sentence: The sun is about to set.

english: Madder (a plant with red roots used for dyeing)
cantonese_sentence: 我好鍾意食茜。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 hou2 zung1 ji3 sik6 sai1.
english_sentence: I really like eating cilantro (coriander). (Note: While "茜" refers to madder, in Cantonese it's often used to refer to cilantro/coriander.)

cantonese_sentence: 佢份proposal真係犀飛利呀！
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 fan6 proposal zan1 hai6 sai1 fei1 lei6 aa3!
english_sentence: His/Her proposal is really fantastic!

cantonese_sentence: 佢啲功夫真係好犀利。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 di1 gung1 fu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai1 lei6.
english_sentence: His kung fu is really awesome.

english: to use, to make, to cause
cantonese_sentence: 唔好使咁多錢啦！
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 sai2 gam3 do1 cin2 laa1!
english_sentence: Don't spend so much money!

english: Can; Able to; Allowed to; Worthwhile
cantonese_sentence: 你嘅提議都使得嘅。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 ge3 tai4 ji5 dou1 sai2 dak1 ge3.
english_sentence: Your suggestion is quite worthwhile/acceptable.

cantonese_sentence: 今個月使費好多。
jyutping_sentence: gam1 go3 jyut6 sai2 fai3 hou2 do1.
english_sentence: This month's expenses are a lot.

english: To be stubborn; to insist on one's own way; to be obstinate.
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好咁使頸啦，聽下人哋嘅意見啦。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 gam3 sai2 geng2 laa1, ting1 haa5 jan4 dei6 ge3 ji3 gin3 laa1.
english_sentence: Don't be so stubborn, listen to other people's opinions.

english: to use, to employ, to utilise
cantonese_sentence: 我哋應該使用環保袋。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ying1 goi1 si2 yung6 waan4 bou2 doi2.
english_sentence: We should use reusable shopping bags.

english: To use cheap labor; to exploit someone for cheap labor
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好成日使𢃇啲後生仔啦！
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 sing4 jat6 sai2 le1 di1 hau6 saang1 zai2 laa1!
english_sentence: Don't always exploit those young people!

english: A nanny; a female caregiver, particularly for children. Can also sometimes have a negative connotation referring to an overbearing or overly intrusive female household worker.
cantonese_sentence: 佢哋請咗個使媽湊仔。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 ceng2 zo2 go3 sai2 maa1 cou3 zai2.
english_sentence: They hired a nanny to take care of the child.

cantonese_sentence: 使乜咁認真呀？
jyutping_sentence: sai2 mat1 gam3 jing6 zan1 aa3?
english_sentence: Why bother being so serious?

english: What's the point of saying (it)?/There's no need to say (it).
cantonese_sentence: 使乜講呀，大家都知佢份人係咁㗎啦。
jyutping_sentence: sai2 mat1 gong2 aa3, daai6 ga1 dou1 zi1 geoi5 fan6 jan4 hai6 gam2 gaa3 laa1.
english_sentence: What's the point of saying it? Everyone knows what kind of person he is already.

english: To work like an ox; to be used and abused, often for little reward.
cantonese_sentence: 你唔好俾佢使牛呀。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 sai2 ngau4 aa3.
english_sentence: Don't let him use you like an ox.

cantonese_sentence: 個使婆好勤力。
jyutping_sentence: go3 sai2 po4 hou2 kan4 lik6.
english_sentence: That cleaning lady is very diligent.

jyutping: sai2 tung4 ngan2 gaap3 daai6 seng1
english: To be stingy despite being rich. (Literally: To use copper coins to make a big noise.)
cantonese_sentence: 佢明明咁有錢，但係都仲要使銅銀夾大聲，真係好孤寒。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 ming4 ming4 gam3 jau5 cin2, daan6 hai6 dou1 zung6 jiu3 sai2 tung4 ngan2 gaap3 daai6 seng1, zan1 hai6 hou2 gu1 hon4.
english_sentence: He's clearly so rich, but he's still stingy, he's really miserly.

english: To use unfair tactics; to play dirty; to be underhanded
cantonese_sentence: 佢比賽嗰陣成日使橫手。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 bei2 coi3 go2 zan6 seng4 jat6 sai2 waang4 sau2.
english_sentence: He always uses unfair tactics during competitions.

cantonese_sentence: 使唔使我幫你手呀？
jyutping_sentence: sai2 m4 sai2 ngo5 bong1 nei5 sau2 aa3?
english_sentence: Do you need me to give you a hand?

english: Get all clean and shiny (often used to refer to bathing, especially for children or animals)
cantonese_sentence: 沖個涼，洗白白先出街啦。
jyutping_sentence: chung1 go3 loeng4, sai2 baak6 baak6 sin1 cheot1 gaai1 laa1.
english_sentence: Take a shower, get all clean before going out.

english: A large, extravagant wedding banquet; to hold an extravagant wedding
cantonese_sentence: 佢哋結婚嗰陣洗咗好多錢洗大餅。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 dei6 git3 fan1 go2 zan6 sai2 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2 sai2 daai6 beng2.
english_sentence: They spent a lot of money to have an extravagant wedding banquet when they got married.

english: To launder one's past; to start with a clean slate; to turn over a new leaf (often after being involved in undesirable or illegal activities).
cantonese_sentence: 佢想洗底，離開黑社會。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sai2 dai2, lei4 hoi1 hak1 se2 wui2.
english_sentence: He wants to clean up his act and leave the triad.

english: To clean up a mess; to cover up a scandal; to do damage control (often politically).
cantonese_sentence: 佢日日喺網上幫佢偶像洗地。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jat6 jat6 hai2 mong5 soeng6 bong1 keoi5 ngau5 zoeng6 sai2 dei6.
english_sentence: They are online every day doing damage control for their idol.

cantonese_sentence: 佢喺地鐵站洗人哋嘅袋。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 hai2 dei6 tit3 zaam6 sai2 jan4 dei6 ge3 doi2.
english_sentence: He pickpocketed someone's bag at the subway station.

cantonese_sentence: 佢晚晚去酒吧洗粉，搞到成個人殘晒。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 maan5 maan5 heoi3 jiu2 baa1 sai2 fan2, gaau2 dou3 sing4 go3 jan4 caan4 saai3.
english_sentence: He goes to the bar every night to snort cocaine, which has made him a wreck.

english: To wash feet and not dry them (meaning: to do something incompletely or to leave a job half-finished)
cantonese_sentence: 你做嘢唔好洗腳唔抹腳，要做好佢啊。
jyutping_sentence: nei5 zou6 je5 m4 hou2 sai2 goek3 m4 maat3 goek3, jiu3 zou6 hou2 keoi5 aa3.
english_sentence: You shouldn't do things incompletely, you need to do them well.

cantonese_sentence: 佢懷疑洗黑錢俾人拉咗
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 ji4 sai2 hak1 cin2 bei2 jan4 laai1 zo2
english_sentence: He's suspected of money laundering and got arrested.

english: To sweep through an apartment building (often for sales or illegal purposes, like drug dealing)
cantonese_sentence: 啲財務公司成日嚟洗樓，好煩！
jyutping_sentence: di1 coi4 mou6 gung1 si1 sing4 jat6 lai4 sai2 lau2, hou2 faan4!
english_sentence: Those finance companies are always sweeping through the building, it's so annoying!

cantonese_sentence: 唔好俾佢哋洗腦啊！
jyutping_sentence: m4 hou2 bei2 keoi5 dei6 sai2 nou5 aa3!
english_sentence: Don't let them brainwash you!

cantonese_sentence: 我哋洗牌先啦！
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 sai2 paai4 sin1 laa1!
english_sentence: Let's shuffle the cards first!

cantonese_sentence: 阿婆仲用洗衫板洗衫。
jyutping_sentence: aa3 po4 zung6 jung6 sai2 saam1 baan2 sai2 saam1.
english_sentence: Grandma still uses a washboard to wash clothes.

cantonese_sentence: 我今日用咗好多洗衫梘嚟洗啲污糟衫。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jung6 zo2 hou2 do1 sai2 saam1 gaan2 lai4 sai2 di1 wu1 zou1 saam1.
english_sentence: I used a lot of laundry soap today to wash the dirty clothes.

english: to bathe; to take a shower
cantonese_sentence: 我沖完涼就去瞓覺。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 cung1 jyun4 loeng4 zau6 heoi3 fan3 gaau3.
english_sentence: I'm going to bed after I take a shower.

english: To be in too deep; to be committed to something and unable to back out easily. Literally, "to have already wet your hair (in preparation for washing it)."
cantonese_sentence: 我哋已經洗濕個頭，一定要做落去。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 dei6 ji5 ging1 sai2 sap1 go3 tau4, jat1 ding6 jiu3 zou6 lok6 heoi3.
english_sentence: We're already in too deep, we have to continue with it.

cantonese_sentence: 食飯之前要洗手。
jyutping_sentence: sik6 faan6 zi1 cin4 jiu3 sai2 sau2.
english_sentence: You need to wash your hands before eating.

cantonese_sentence: 我想去洗手間。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 sai2 sau2 gaan1.
english_sentence: I want to go to the toilet/restroom/bathroom.

english: To cover up a scandal or wrongdoing; to whitewash; to sanitize a situation
cantonese_sentence: 佢想洗太平地，但係大家都知發生咩事。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 soeng2 sai2 taai3 ping4 dei6, daan6 hai6 daai6 gaa1 dou1 zi1 faat3 sang1 me1 si6.
english_sentence: He wants to cover things up, but everyone knows what happened.

english: To undergo stomach pumping or gastric lavage (usually after ingesting something poisonous)
cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗好多漂白水，要即刻送佢去醫院洗肚！
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zo2 hou2 do1 piu3 bak6 seoi2, jiu3 zik1 hak1 sung3 keoi5 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 sai2 tou5!
english_sentence: He drank a lot of bleach, we need to send him to the hospital immediately for stomach pumping!

cantonese_sentence: 佢懷疑洗緊黑錢。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 waai4 ji4 sai2 gan2 hak1 cin2.
english_sentence: He is suspected of laundering black money.

cantonese_sentence: 佢飲咗好多滴露，要即刻送佢去醫院洗胃。
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 jam2 zo2 ho2 do1 dik6 lou6, jiu3 zik1 hak1 sung3 keoi5 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 sai2 wai6.
english_sentence: He drank a lot of Dettol, we need to immediately send him to the hospital for a stomach pump.

english: Uncle (respectful term for a man roughly the age of one's father, but not a blood relative)
cantonese_sentence: 陳生，我同你世伯飲杯!
jyutping_sentence: can4 sang1, ngo5 tung4 nei5 sai3 baak3 yam2 bui1!
english_sentence: Mr. Chan, let me drink a cup with your uncle!

english: (Referring to) one's sister's son or daughter; nephew (in older times, also used generally to address a younger male generation, showing respect)
cantonese_sentence: 李伯，你個世侄真係一表人才！
jyutping_sentence: lei5 baak3, nei5 go3 sai3 zat6 zan1 hai6 jat1 biu2 jan4 coi4!
english_sentence: Uncle Lee, your nephew is truly a talented and promising individual!

cantonese_sentence: 我想去世界各地旅行。
jyutping_sentence: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 sai3 gaai3 gok3 dei6 leoi5 haang4.
english_sentence: I want to travel to different parts of the world.

cantonese_sentence: 佢嗰球世界波真係好靚呀！
jyutping_sentence: keoi5 go2 kau4 sai3 gaai3 bo1 zan1 hai6 hou2 leng3 aa3!
english_sentence: That world-class goal he scored was really beautiful!

english: A worldly, opportunistic, street-smart person; a person who knows how to get ahead, often by being charming or manipulative. Can have negative connotations, suggesting someone who is morally flexible.
